overall_notes: The paper focuses on exemplar selection for in-context learning in HybridQA tasks. The NLG aspect is code generation where the model generates Python code to answer questions based on hybrid text and table contexts. Evaluation uses automatic metrics (Execution Accuracy and Exact Match) without human or LLM-as-judge evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate, requiring only minor normalization.
